s0401.literal: One hundred twenty-four posts of associate prefect, assistant and deputy officials, Confucian instructors, and Mongol instructors at Dali, Greater Cheli, Lesser Cheli, and other places in Yunnan were abolished.
s0401.idiomatic: 124 posts of associate prefect, assistant and deputy officials, Confucian instructors, and Mongol instructors at Dali, Greater Cheli, Lesser Cheli, and other places in Yunnan were abolished.

s0402.literal: On bingyin day the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.
s0402.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.

s0403.literal: On jisi day the former system for clerk-origin officials was restored; those guilty of corruption were limited to rank 7b.
s0403.idiomatic: On jisi day the former system for clerk-origin officials was restored; those guilty of corruption were limited to rank 7b.

s0404.literal: Corvée levies of YanYou seventh year were remitted in Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe.
s0404.idiomatic: Corvée levies of YanYou seventh year were remitted in Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe.

s0405.literal: Garrison-farm fields were established in the Tatara region of Hexi, and a military-civilian wanhu office was established.
s0405.idiomatic: Garrison-farm fields were established in the Tatara region of Hexi, and a military-civilian wanhu office was established.

s0406.literal: On renshen day the moon transgressed Star.
s0406.idiomatic: On renshen day the moon transgressed Star.

s0407.literal: Grand councillor Wang Yi resigned on grounds of his parents' age; it was granted, and silks and cloths were still bestowed on his father.
s0407.idiomatic: Grand councillor Wang Yi resigned on grounds of his parents' age; it was granted, and silks and cloths were still bestowed on his father.

s0408.literal: On guiyou day, that night wind and snow were very cold; the Emperor said to attending ministers, "We and you dwell in warm rooms, while imperial kin and brothers guard the distant frontier — how can they bear such hardship!
s0408.idiomatic: On guiyou day, that night wind and snow were very cold; the Emperor said to attending ministers, "We and you dwell in warm rooms, while imperial kin and brothers guard the distant frontier — how can they bear such hardship!

s0409.literal: The annual grants of money and silks — can they not reach everywhere?
s0409.idiomatic: The annual grants of money and silks — can they not reach everywhere?

s0410.literal: " An edict directed that at Shangdu and Dadu, food stations be set up along the roads in winter and summer to feed the hungry.
s0410.idiomatic: An edict directed that at Shangdu and Dadu, food stations be set up along the roads in winter and summer to feed the hungry.

s0411.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, on xinsi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0411.idiomatic: Seventh year, spring, first month, on xinsi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0412.literal: The Emperor observed fasting and reduced meals, and waived court congratulations.
s0412.idiomatic: The Emperor observed fasting and reduced meals, and waived court congratulations.

s0413.literal: On renwu day Censorate officials said, "Recently Burkhan Ding's mountain preserve and Wanzhezhe's sea-vessel tax were granted; calculating their notes, each amounts to several hundred thousand ingots — for impoverished princes, troops, and commoners, grants have never been on this scale; if we do not practice economy, the treasury will gradually be emptied and the people will grow yet more distressed.
s0413.idiomatic: On renwu day censorate officials said, "Recently Burkhan Ding's mountain preserve and Wanzhezhe's sea-vessel tax were granted; calculating their notes, each amounts to several hundred thousand ingots — for impoverished princes, troops, and commoners, grants have never been on this scale; if we do not practice economy, the treasury will gradually be emptied and the people will grow yet more distressed.

s0414.literal: " Central secretariat officials advanced and said, "What the censorate officials say is quite correct; if we do not rectify court discipline, law and regulation will grow worse still.
s0414.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials advanced and said, "What the censorate officials say is quite correct; if we do not rectify court discipline, law and regulation will grow worse still.

s0415.literal: We beg to be dismissed and replaced with selection of worthy men.
s0415.idiomatic: We beg to be dismissed and replaced with selection of worthy men.

s0416.literal: " The Emperor said, "You need not speak thus; each of you should jointly attend to your duties.
s0416.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "You need not speak thus; each of you should jointly attend to your duties.

s0417.literal: " On guiwei day the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received the court congratulations of princes and all officials.
s0417.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received the court congratulations of princes and all officials.

s0418.literal: On xinmao day Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat chancellor Heilü said, "The White Cloud monk Shen Mingren on his own authority ordained more than four thousand eight hundred monks, obtaining more than forty thousand ingots; having already confessed, he now sends his disciple Shen Chongsheng secretly to the capital to bribe and seek rescue; We request he be arrested and sent to Jiang-Zhe and punished together with his offense.
s0418.idiomatic: On xinmao day Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat chancellor Heilü said, "The White Cloud monk Shen Mingren on his own authority ordained more than 4,800 monks, obtaining more than 40,000 ingots; having already confessed, he now sends his disciple Shen Chongsheng secretly to the capital to bribe and seek rescue; We request he be arrested and sent to Jiang-Zhe and punished together with his offense.

s0420.literal: On yiwei day the moon transgressed the upper star of Mingtang.
s0420.idiomatic: On yiwei day the moon transgressed the upper star of Mingtang.

s0421.literal: On dinghai day the Emperor fell ill.
s0421.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor fell ill.

s0422.literal: On xinchou day the Emperor died at Guangtian Palace; he was thirty-six years old and had reigned ten years.
s0422.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor died at Guangtian Palace; he was 36 years old and had reigned 10 years.

s0423.literal: On guimao day he was buried at Qinian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
s0423.idiomatic: On guimao day he was buried at Qinian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

s0424.literal: Fifth month, yiwei day: the assembled officials presented the posthumous title Shengwen Qinxiao Emperor; temple name Renzong; in the national language Buyan Du Emperor.
s0424.idiomatic: Fifth month, yiwei day: the assembled officials presented the posthumous title Shengwen Qinxiao Emperor; temple name Renzong; in the national language Buyan Du Emperor.

s0425.literal: Renzong was by nature filial and benevolent, intelligent, respectful, and frugal; he mastered Confucian learning and deeply comprehended Buddhist scriptures; he once said, "To clarify the mind and see one's nature, Buddhism goes deeper;
s0425.idiomatic: Renzong was by nature filial and benevolent, intelligent, respectful, and frugal; he mastered Confucian learning and deeply comprehended Buddhist scriptures; he once said, "To clarify the mind and see one's nature, Buddhism goes deeper;

s0426.literal: to cultivate the person and govern the state, the Confucian Way is more urgent.
s0426.idiomatic: to cultivate the person and govern the state, the Confucian Way is more urgent.

s0427.literal: " He also said, "Confucian scholars deserve esteem, for they can uphold the Way of the Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues.
s0427.idiomatic: He also said, "Confucian scholars deserve esteem, for they can uphold the Way of the Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues.

s0428.literal: " In daily life his dress and equipage were plain; he was detached and without desire; he did not engage in hunting excursions, did not delight in military campaigns, and did not exalt profit and goods.
s0428.idiomatic: In daily life his dress and equipage were plain; he was detached and without desire; he did not engage in hunting excursions, did not delight in military campaigns, and did not exalt profit and goods.

s0429.literal: In serving the empress dowager, he never went against her countenance throughout his life;
s0429.idiomatic: In serving the empress dowager, he never went against her countenance throughout his life;

s0430.literal: in treating imperial kin and meritorious elders, he always observed rites from beginning to end.
s0430.idiomatic: in treating imperial kin and meritorious elders, he always observed rites from beginning to end.

s0431.literal: When ministers had aged parents, he would timely add marks of favor;
s0431.idiomatic: When ministers had aged parents, he would timely add marks of favor;

s0432.literal: when the Imperial Kitchen presented meals, he always divided and bestowed them on the honored and those near at hand.
s0432.idiomatic: when the Imperial Kitchen presented meals, he always divided and bestowed them on the honored and those near at hand.

s0433.literal: When officials reported capital punishment cases, he would always grow deeply sorrowful for a long while.
s0433.idiomatic: When officials reported capital punishment cases, he would always grow deeply sorrowful for a long while.

s0434.literal: Thus in his tireless governance, he wholly followed Shizu's established institutions.
s0434.idiomatic: Thus in his tireless governance, he wholly followed Shizu's established institutions.
